verdict.rationale: The docs describe plural-document operations: upserting, fetching, and deleting docs (moss-docs-22), crawling a whole website into an index (moss-docs-9), and loading several indexes at once for a single query (moss-docs-18). This suggests batch-style handling of many items, and agents can add and manage documents via the MCP server and AI SDK tools (moss-docs-11, moss-docs-14). However, nothing explicitly documents a bulk or batch API, its limits, or cross-index bulk management. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented batch/bulk endpoint with size limits, bulk operations across indexes (not just documents), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
